2607.28573.title: Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs
2607.28573.paper_summary: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.
2607.28573.paper_summary_zh: 部署自主計算機使用代理（CUAs）在本地變得越來越重要，這對於隱私、成本效益和實用性至關重要，但在嚴格的硬體限制下提高其性能仍然具有挑戰性。雖然最近的研究顯示推理時間擴展可以通過執行過程中的額外計算來改善前沿計算機使用代理，但其在資源受限的本地模型中的有效性仍然不甚了解。<lb/>我們對本地CUAs中的推理時間擴展進行了系統的實證研究，涵蓋了上下文、時間、結構和並行維度。<lb/>我們在OSWorld基準上評估了Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B和OpenCUA-7B。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，額外的計算通常會產生遞減的回報，同時改變失敗模式。<lb/>上下文擴展提供了歷史基礎，改善了軌跡穩定性和任務準確性，但隨著標記成本的增加，其增益會飽和，失敗模式也會從重複或停滯的軌跡轉向過早的虛假成功。<lb/>時間擴展同樣減少了最大步驟停滯，但並未實質性提高任務成功率，這表明較長的時間範圍往往延長了錯誤的軌跡而不是修正它們。<lb/>我們進一步發現，結構分解可能會在本地兩階段代理中引入規劃和格式化的開銷，而並行擴展在相當大的計算成本下部分減輕了這些失敗。<lb/>總體而言，我們的研究結果表明，高效的本地CUAs需要選擇性計算分配、關注失敗的控制機制，以及圍繞本地模型的能力和限制設計的代理框架。
